name: file_close

ownership.argument: Closes a pinned file record; it is also the producer that confirms the file record layout the module reads when it validates the loop's pipe.

provenance.source: Checks the record, loads file+16 as the inode, then inode+16 as i_ops and calls the close handler at i_ops+4 with the record. Asserts from ../../nuttx/fs/vfs/fs_close.c line 94.

notes: Confirms FILE_INODE = 16 together with register_inode storing the operations table at inode+16.
